limits.label: Archive slots

limits.label: Archive size

limits.label: Zip format
limits.value: STORED only; no zip comment; local extra length equal to central extra length; entry names [a-z0-9_.-]+, no space or comma, no language prefix; a name only in ONE override archive; configpc.txt must end with a newline
limits.effect: deflate entries are fed raw (crash); a comment shifts the end record (garbage counts); a missing newline silently drops the whole filesystem value (game runs vanilla)
limits.confidence: MEASURED for STORED and for the split into 2 archives (HD in-game); the rest INFERRED

limits.label: Entry-name hash

limits.effect: a colliding name hijacks another file (wrong file served, likely crash)
limits.confidence: INFERRED (HD checked 0 collisions for its names; new names unchecked)
